morphologies.name: Wild type
morphologies.biological_role: Normal wild-type anterior-posterior polarity (1 head, 1 trunk with 1 pharynx, 1 tail).

morphologies.name: Double head, two pharynxes
morphologies.biological_role: Bipolar two-headed planarian with duplicated pharynx induced by octanol gap-junction blockade or triple innexin RNAi (Oviedo et al. 2010).

morphologies.name: Side head
morphologies.biological_role: Ectopic lateral head branching off the trunk with secondary pharynx and VNC.

morphologies.name: Headless
morphologies.biological_role: Acephalic / headless regenerant (trunk + tail only, no brain or eyes).

morphologies.name: Double head, one pharynx
morphologies.biological_role: Bipolar two-headed planarian with a single central pharynx.
